decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out accessories like cases and chargers to focus specifically on portable speakers. My consideration set includes a mix of premium brands (Bose, Bang & Olufsen), niche European design (Libratone), and high-performance budget options (Raymate, Ortizan). The Bose SoundLink Color II was ultimately chosen because of its exceptional review count of over 62,000 and high rating of 4.6, suggesting a consistent and reliable user experience for a mid-range price. While the Bang & Olufsen offers superior sound quality, the price jump is significant, and the Bose fits the sweet spot for a versatile outdoor/indoor portable speaker.
